watch.summary: A streamer attempts to camouflage his character in plain sight between two bottles by painting himself to match them.

beats.what: The streamer hears voice chat laughing at his hiding spot.
He finishes painting his body half-white and half-brown to match the two condiment bottles.
He stands still right between the bottles, looking blatantly obvious.
He chuckles and hopes the seeker is 'probably blind'.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The visual visual gag of a human character painting himself to blend in between two bottles in plain sight is instantly funny. His quiet insistence that the seeker might just be blind adds a nice bit of comedic denial.
